T1.note: unit + demos + non-Docker integration (integration/services subtree excluded - it is Docker-real and runs in T2); floor = measured minus ~2% slack. Raised for 12.3, then 12.2.6 (test tie-back), then 12.4, and now 12.5 (usage channel model/schema/ingestion/API, agent dispatch + prompt, control-runtime usage shipping, ad-hoc agent runs: no-legacy-enqueue, playground control mode, the extended verify_executor gate). Re-measured 1974 -> 2062 by the 12.5 VERIFIER after the adversarial-review fixes landed: the mid-phase 1974 was taken before the three fix agents finished adding their regression tests, so it was never a real ceiling. The verifier's own +4 are the two ad-hoc-trigger drift guards (schemas vs agent_run vocabulary) and the three real-LocalExecutor image_declares_label seam tests. Raise when suites grow (ratchet up, never down without a PLAN.md note).

T2.note: Docker-dependent integration (tdd/integration/services: executor + 12.2-INT workspace lifecycle/local pipeline/WS round-trip suites + 12.3 HOME-persistence + base-image contracts on lazyaf-base:dev). Docker down fails loudly in the shared docker_client fixture (tdd/integration/conftest.py). Step images are a PREFLIGHT: run_tier.py T2 runs `build_images.py --check` before pytest and exits loudly with the rebuild command, so the '12.3-images:' skip reason is gone from skip_baseline.json and image-dependent tests always execute under the gate - the floor counts them. Re-measured after the 12.2.6/12.4 wave (base-image contract suite grew with the LAZYAF_TEST_RESULTS_PATH runtime contracts), and again by the 12.5 verifier: 60 -> 64 with tdd/integration/services/test_agent_step_container.py (secret containment against a real `docker inspect`, the agent-step round trip on lazyaf-agent-base:dev, and the non-agent-image preflight message). Measured with all five step images rebuilt from scratch.

T3.note: e2e quick tier (tdd/e2e -m 'not slow'). Raised at 12.5 for tdd/e2e/test_us2_card_loop.py - the US-2 loop (card -> agent -> gate -> review -> merge) is deliberately NOT slow: it runs against the mock agent at zero cost, so US-2 is covered on every push. T3 also gained the same `build_images.py --check` preflight T2 has (scripts/run_tier.py), because agent steps spawn lazyaf-agent-base:dev containers. Known exclusion (R4, stated not silent): the @slow e2e tests (control layer control-mode round trip, real card execution, graph pipeline full-stack) run in NO tier and have no floor here - they need the compose e2e stack, which a step container cannot host yet. Host-runnable via the scripts/test slow lane. Tier selections are single-sourced in scripts/run_tier.py.
